findings.42: Expected Hero/Normal Power+Fly ivory skull/body, violet cuffs, gold wing details/chest and pink hollow halo. Original eyes and alpha silhouettes remain intact across all angles.
findings.43: Expected Neutral/Normal Power+Swim cyan skull and green body/limbs with yellow orb. Original face/iris pixels visibly intact. No Fly palette route.
findings.44: Expected Neutral/Swim Run+Swim green skull with cyan lower face, cyan forehead V, yellow limbs/feet and pale cyan orb. Front/side/below face and wing silhouettes intact.
findings.45: Expected Dark/Normal Run+Fly dark plum body, violet/lavender cuffs/feet and independent peach spiked marker, with subdued olive wings. Original eyes/alpha silhouettes intact; no new Fly material route.
